title: Nine Inches of Stone
subtitle: 基础与基地 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 基础与基地（生活与学习·建造与依据）
meta: 主题语境：基础与基地（生活与学习·建造与依据）　|　核心词汇：base　|　正文 335 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 base 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1951 my father laid ① a base of nine inches of stone and said the wall would outlive him, and my mother said the stone was the whole of the marriage. The ② base, meaning the layer and not the wall, was never seen again and was never mentioned; a base, he said, is the only part of a building that is judged by what it prevents.

Every ③ base in that field was measured on a Saturday, and the ④ base by the hedge, meaning the one that sank and not either of those, was dug out and done again in March. A base, my grandmother said, is nine parts digging and one part admitting you dug badly; my father said the admitting is the expensive half.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ base was the whole of the argument, meaning the reason and not the stone. The ⑥ base, meaning the grounds and not any of that, is the only thing in a disagreement that both sides claim and neither can show; a base, he said, is either what you build on or the only word that means both a foundation and a reason. She said the reason came second.

By 1964 the ⑦ base had become a line on a map, and the line had become an argument about who had drawn it. The ⑧ base of the whole thing, my father wrote in June, was nine inches of stone and eleven years of silence; a base, he said, is either the layer under the wall or the reason you never had to talk about the wall. She said the silence was the part that cost.

The ⑨ base I remember is the one by the hedge, which held for forty years and was only mentioned when it failed. A ⑩ base, my mother said in 1991, is the only thing that improves by being forgotten; every base, she said, is a reason that has agreed to look like stone. He said the stone was the proof.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 地基（指那一层，与墙相对）
C. 固定搭配：lay a base 打地基
D. n. 地基（指那块地里每一处）
E. n. 地基（指树篱边那一处）
G. n. 依据（抽象：理由这件事）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a base of nine inches of stone
The base, meaning the layer and not the wall
base was the whole of the argument
the base had become a line on a map
The base of the whole thing
A base, my mother said in 1991

answers.why: lay a base 意为“打地基”，1951 年父亲铺了九英寸厚的石头地基，说这堵墙会比他活得久。
base 意为“地基”，指那一层而不是墙，此后再没被人看见，也没被提起过。
base 指那块地里每一处地基，每一处都是星期六量的。
base 指树篱边那一处（下沉的那一处），三月被挖出来重做了一遍。
base 意为“依据、理由”，叔叔说 base 就是那场争论的全部，指的是理由而不是石头。
base 为抽象用法，指理由这件事，是一场分歧里双方都主张、却谁也拿不出来的东西。
base 意为“地基、基底”，到 1964 年这个 base 成了地图上的一条线。
base 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，父亲六月写道，整件事权衡下来是九英寸石头和十一年的沉默。
base 意为“地基”，我记得的是树篱边那一处，它撑了四十年，只在出问题那天被提起。
base 为抽象总称，母亲说地基是唯一会因为被遗忘而变好的东西。
